tokens.name: layout.primary

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Concise specifications remain close to the chart they produce.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Declarative chart canvas with layered marks, facets, and a concise specification. Charts and diagrams are evidence, with labels and alternatives that keep them interpretable.
